description_en: Enables or disables the logon-free sharing feature for a Browser Monitoring site. After this feature is enabled, you can access the Browser Monitoring page by using the URL obtained by calling the GetRetcodeShareUrl operation
description_zh: 打开或关闭前端监控站点的免登录分享开关，打开该功能后即可通过调用GetRetcodeShareUrl接口获取的地址访问前端监控页面
name: SetRetcodeShareStatus

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

In the ARMS console, choose Browser Monitoring > Browser Monitoring List and click the target application name. The URL in the browser address bar contains the pid of the frontend application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the URL, you must modify the pid in the xxx%40xxx format. For example, if the pid in the URL is eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****, replace %40 with @. The result is eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的前端监控 > 前端列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含前端应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，应用需要对xxx%40xxx格式的pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****，则需要将%40替换为@，即：eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en:
The status of the logon-free sharing feature for the Browser Monitoring site. Valid values:

`true`: Enabled.
`false`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设置前端监控站点的免登录分享开关的状态。取值：

`true`：开启。
`false`：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the Browser Monitoring application
parameters.name: app_name

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The operation was successful.
`false`: The operation failed
IsSuccess.description_zh:
操作是否成功：

`true`：操作成功
`false`：操作失败
